messages:
Morgan: Quick follow-up from the authz postmortem — one thread to track outstanding rotation + audit items. I want owners and realistic dates so we can close these in the next sprint.
Alex: 👍 sure. I'll start.
Rita: Can we confirm which keys still haven't been rotated? I saw a partial run on Friday.
Sam (sec): There were 3 tokens that failed validation and one missing audit entry. I dumped the list to /opt/incidents/authz-2026-03-18.log — sending excerpt below.
incident-bot: Automated note: postmortem #2026-03-18 created, follow-ups due by 2026-03-31.
Alex: Excerpt: ```
failed_tokens = ["svc-ingest-us-east:rot-v1", "ci-runner:legacy", "billing-proxy:stale-2023"]
missing_audit = ["billing-proxy:stale-2023"]
```
Rita: Thanks. I'll take `billing-proxy:stale-2023` and owner handoff. ETA end of day Friday (2026-03-27).
Sam (sec): I'll own revalidation and audit log backfill for the other two tokens. Estimate: 3 workdays.
Priya: Can we get a simple rollback / kill-switch plan documented in runbook so oncall can quickly revoke if something misbehaves?
Theo: I'll add a compact runbook snippet to the playbook. Tentative: `revoke-token --id <token> --dry-run` then `revoke-token --id <token> --force` with a dashboard link. Will post exact commands.
Morgan: Action list (quick): 1) rotate `billing-proxy:stale-2023` — Rita — 2026-03-27; 2) revalidate + backfill audit — Sam — 2026-03-30; 3) runbook kill-switch + test — Theo — 2026-03-26; 4) weekly token-health cron (alerts) — Alex — 2026-04-02. Please ack.
Alex: Ack. I'll add a monitoring job: cron -> run token-validate-suite -> post metrics to telemetry/token-health.
Rita: Ack. I'll rotate keys and open PR for deploy checklist.
Sam (sec): Ack. I'll also add a one-off migration job to backfill audit entries using the event store.
Priya: Can we add an SLO for token-validation failures so we get alerted earlier? Even 5% failure over median is fine.
Alex: Good idea. I'll add a dashboard and alert: token_validation_failure_rate > 2% for 15m -> page oncall.
Morgan: Also flagging recurring pattern: two incidents in 6 months around stale service tokens. Proposal: quarterly sweep + ownership map. Assign a permanent owner per service group.
Rita: I can coordinate a quarterly sweep with infra owners — propose first sweep 2026-04-15.
Theo: I will run a quick dry run of the kill-switch on staging Wednesday and post results.
incident-bot: Reminder set: follow-up check-in scheduled 2026-03-31 15:00 UTC.
Morgan: Thanks all — please update the postmortem checklist in the incident doc with the PR links when done. If anyone hits blockers ping me or @Priya. :thumbsup:
